plan.notes: Source: official 2026-2027 UACCM catalog (pp. 52-53), transcribed from PDF layout this session. Catalog has genuine inconsistency: ELECTIVES header says 16-17 credit hours but prose says 25-26 hours; seeded per header lower bound. Ranged sections (MATH 3-6, US HIST 3-9, SOC SCI 3-6, FINE ARTS 6-9) seeded at values summing to 44 core + 15 electives = 59; catalog prints 60-61 Semester Hours.
